identificationModule.officialTitle: A Safety and Efficacy Study of Autologous Chimeric Antigen Receptor Engineered T Cells Redirected to EGFRvIII in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety of infusion of autologous anti-EGFRvIII CAR T cells with cyclophosphamide and fludarabine as lymphodepleting chemotherapy in patients with recurrent glioblastoma using the NCI CTCAE V4.0 criteria.
primaryOutcomes.description: incidents of treatment related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE V4.0.

secondaryOutcomes.description: defined as the proportion of patients who achieved complete remission (CR), partial remission (PR), stable disease (SD), or progressive disease (PD).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Persistence of CAR T cells in patients

otherOutcomes.measure: Proliferation of CAR T cells in patients
otherOutcomes.description: CAR T cell proliferation in patients is monitored by flow or qPCR
